title: Cache partitioner requires correct modulus AND health degradation report
description: The assign_partition function must use hash(key) % num_partitions (not num_partitions + 1) AND report degradation via orgops.health.report_degradation for operational monitoring.
code:
# Cache Partition Assignment — Two Requirements

## 1. Correct Modulus
```python
partition_id = _stable_hash(key) % num_partitions
```
Never use `num_partitions + 1` — that produces out-of-range IDs.

## 2. Health Degradation Report (REQUIRED)
```python
import orgops.health
orgops.health.report_degradation("cache.partition.skew", partition_id)
```
